decision.description: Which SKILL.md step decided the outcome.

labels.description: Labels to ADD, exact names from labels.json. Never list labels to remove.

templates.description: templates.json keys whose comment should be posted, in order.

possible_duplicate.description: One ordinary same-repository issue that may report the same underlying bug, after reading its body and relevant comments. Suggestion only: the source stays open. Use with label or triage_review, never with umbrella or a close decision.

issue.description: One candidate from this repository's checked-in umbrellas.json catalog; never a URL.

match.description: covered means full issue/comment context establishes the catalog scope and exclusions; uncertain permits only a link and human review. The catalog, not the model, chooses link or close.

umbrella.description: Optional approved umbrella reference on the new issue. Do not combine with a close decision; info/reproduction requests remain link-only.

reasoning.description: 2-6 sentences: what the issue is about and why these labels.
